relevance.rationale: Fujii, Osaka J. Math. 27 (1990) 539-553, on compact oriented hyperbolic 3-manifolds with totally geodesic boundary (whose boundary is then a hyperbolic surface). Same structural situation as library/0504116v2/0504116v2.pdf in this slice: the corpus's hyperbolic 3-manifold objects are all CUSPED complements with ideal triangulations -- m004, L5a1, L6a4 -- and 'geodesic boundary' does not occur anywhere in content/, docs/ or computations/. There is no truncated-tetrahedron or compact-with-boundary object for these results to attach to, and no corpus question about volumes or structures in that class. Scope-(a): as read, this document supplies nothing usable here; the geodesic-boundary class is not thereby excluded from future use.

proposedActions.rationale: No corpus object in the totally-geodesic-boundary class. Note for the merge that this slice contains two independent uploads on that theme (this and 0504116v2), suggesting a deliberate but so-far-unconsumed intake direction.
